pr.title: Dedupe Stripe refund webhooks (fix double refunds, INC-2291)
pr.author: dev-b

author_content.body:
## Problem
Stripe retries `charge.refunded` webhooks on timeouts (at-least-once delivery). Today `handleRefundEvent` has no dedupe, so a redelivered event credits the customer balance twice. Incident INC-2291 (2 customers double-refunded last month). Closes #377.

## Approach
- New `processed_events` table (migration 0043, additive only).
- Before applying, look up the event in `processed_events`; if present, return `duplicate`.
- Apply refund and record the event in the **same DB transaction**, so a crash between the two can't leave a half-applied state.

## Data flow
Stripe → `POST /webhooks/stripe` → `handleRefundEvent(event)` → dedupe lookup → `applyRefund(tx, charge, amount)` + insert `processed_events` (one txn) → 200.

Not changed: signature verification, other event types, `applyRefund` itself.

## Verification
- `npm test -- tests/webhooks/refundHandler.test.ts` — 3 tests: single apply, duplicate skipped, unknown charge rejected. CI `test` job green: https://github.com/acme/billing/actions/runs/9911
- Ran migration up/down locally on a copy of staging schema.
